preferences.question: How packed should each day be?
preferences.user_value: Slow: one or two things a day.

preferences.question: How much should the trip cost?
What kind of food should the plan be built around?

description: Q4, mixed-values user who states budget, night, food (high side) at turn 0; turn 1 corrects pace (low side).

turns.user: Can you plan a weekend in Tokyo for me? Money isn't an issue, I'm happy to splurge. I love late nights out. I'll eat anything and love trying adventurous local food.
That's way too packed. I like a slow pace, one or two things a day at most. Can you redo it?
Great. I've decided to stay an extra day. Can you plan Monday too?
A friend is joining me on Saturday. Can you redo Saturday for the two of us?
